buttercream.$description: Buttercream — Page canvas, card surfaces, and warm backgrounds — the dominant neutral that gives the entire UI its sun-warmed temperature

marigold.$description: Marigold — Primary CTA fill, brand accent — school-bus yellow that carries the only chromatic voice in the system, reserved exclusively for action surfaces

ink-black.$description: Ink Black — Primary text, borders, icon strokes, and structural outlines — near-universal use, defines the high-contrast ledger feel

bone-white.$description: Bone White — Reversed text on dark fills, surface inversion, and contrast pairings against black

char.$description: Char — Secondary surfaces and muted structural fills where warm cream is too light to carry a block

oat.$description: Oat — Neutral button borders and subtle dividers where pure black would be too heavy

fawn.$description: Fawn — Faint cool-tinted neutral for secondary surface layers and quiet dividers

sans-serif.$description: sans-serif — detected in extracted data but not described by AI

champ.$description: Display and headline typeface — chunky slab serif at weight 800 for hero and large headings, weight 500 for sub-display sizes. The tight lineHeight (1.01 at 72px) and +0.01em tracking let lines stack aggressively. This is the brand's voice carrier; headlines should feel carved, not typeset

dm-sans.$description: Body, UI labels, buttons, and small interface text — the workhorse neutral grotesque. 400 for body copy, 500 for labels, 700 for emphasized UI text. Negative tracking (-0.02em) at 20px tightens small headings, positive tracking (0.016em) at 10px adds air to micro labels

dm-mono.$description: Monospaced accent for ledger-style numerical data, prices, and technical callouts where monospaced alignment reinforces the financial-document feel

arial.$description: Arial — detected in extracted data but not described by AI
